heroHeadline: Istanbul Court Keeps İmamoğlu Jailed; CHP Leader Under Criminal Investigation
heroSubtitle: An Istanbul court rejected release requests in the political espionage case against Mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu on May 13, while prosecutors opened a separate criminal investigation against CHP leader Özgür Özel on May 8. Turkey simultaneously navigates its Iran ceasefire mediation role and prepares to host NATO's July 2026 Ankara Summit. Inflation at 32.37% (April 2026) and the lira near 45.5/USD remain core economic pressures as the central bank holds its rate at 37%.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets (Reuters, BBC, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, TRT World, Euronews), institutional analyses (ICG, HRW, Freedom House), and authoritative historical scholarship.
